item.description:
Added

  • Settings > Updates shows expandable release notes for each update in the

published feed, newest first, with installed-build identification and refresh.

  • Source links containing both a Marketo token and a # anchor now have an

adaptive orange background and a warning triangle in the line-number gutter.

Markers update as the source is edited without changing copied or exported code.

  • Show in Source in the token/anchor review jumps directly to the affected URL.

Fixed

  • Globe plain-text conversion now recognizes Watch now as a CTA, preserving

its complete URL and tracking parameters on a separate line.

Added

  • Link Report Copy Image copies a PNG of the entire sorted report, including

column headers and all rows, with wrapped URLs and notes.

Changed

  • The onboarding Watch Folders step now points out the menu bar paper-plane

icon and explains how it shows status, controls folders, and reopens the app.

  • Help Center Watch Folders guidance now documents the menu bar controls and

clarifies that closing the main window leaves Jetstream running.

Fixed

  • Force the mounted preview renderer to lay out immediately when its

orientation changes, so selecting Rotate visibly updates the device frame.
